svg.title: Acceptance differs despite few benchmark-failing approvals
svg.desc: Two panels show approval of benchmark-passing and benchmark-failing patches in follow-up common-task sets. Three colored points per scenario include task-level conservative intervals; zero observed approvals do not imply zero risk.
svg.text: Acceptance differs despite few benchmark-failing approvals
Follow-up · same tasks across all three models within each scenario · two usable repeats required
Whiskers: conservative 95% task-level sensitivity intervals; not independent-review or population intervals.
Matched within each scenario; denominators are per model. The task set can differ between scenarios.
A Issue + patch only B Factual summary C Full report, source unspecified
D Full report attributed to patch-producing system E Identical report attributed to a separate evaluator
Source labels are hypothetical. Sonnet uses a native JSON constraint in the follow-up phase.
Post-hoc benchmark scoring. B–E use evidence from the same evaluation defining the labels, not independent verification.
40 planned tasks · 7 invalid responses · 64 unattempted. Common-task subsets omit missing blocks; no imputation.
